name: Technical Audience
description: People with technical knowledge or expertise in a specific field, such as engineers, scientists, or developers

characteristics.knowledge_level: High in their domain, varied in peripheral domains
characteristics.attention_span: Extended for relevant technical content, short for general topics
characteristics.typical_objections: Questions about methodology, technical feasibility, and implementation details

content.depth: Detailed technical information with proper context
content.evidence: Data, research, benchmarks, and technical specifications
content.logical_flow: Structured progression from fundamentals to applications

delivery.pace: Moderate, with time to process complex information
delivery.language: Precise technical terminology appropriate to the field
delivery.interaction: Q&A focused on technical details and implications

visual_elements.preferred_types: Diagrams, charts, code samples, architecture diagrams

engagement_strategies: Reference technical challenges they likely face
Provide concrete examples and use cases
Connect technical details to practical applications
Allow time for in-depth technical questions
communication_pitfalls: Focusing on marketing rather than technical merit

effective_approaches.opening: Establish technical credibility and relevance to their work
effective_approaches.structure: Clear framework with logical progression and technical depth

academic.approach: More emphasis on background research and literature

industry.approach: More emphasis on use cases and integration

decision_makers.approach: Connect technical details to business outcomes
